description.value: The Nature House at Red Barn is a seasonal nature interpretation centre operated by Metro Vancouver Parks within Campbell Valley Regional Park near Langley. It focuses on natural history and functions as a visitor centre for park guests. Campbell Valley is a popular multi-use regional park, making this a worthwhile stop for touring cyclists exploring the Lower Mainland trail network.
